Title: Academy of Technology
Home About Contact Events Highlights Academics Departments Library moodle Alumni LogIn Departments Library moodle Established in 2007, Academy of Technology is one of the most acclaimed self-financed engineering colleges in Karnataka. It has been established by SPDY Educational Development & Charitable Organisation (SPDYEDCO), a trust known for its deep sense of social commitment and dedicated to the promotion of education by inculcating appropriate ethics and attitude. In a metamorphosis of over 18 years, Academy of Technology has been reinventing itself constantly to explore the infinite possibilities of engineering and technology – an academy that inspires everyone to think differently. It is now the preferred career destination for meritorious students due to its academic integrity and standard as well as its attractive campus placement. The total fee payable at the time of admission for regular students is ₹1,05,200. The total fee payable at the time of admission for students allotted through TFW is ₹53,200. The tuition fee per semester is ₹52,000. Yes, there are additional fees charged by the University, which include: 1) University Development Fees @ ₹550 per year (one-time payment of ₹2,200) 2) University Registration Fees @ ₹500 (one-time payment) Yes, the caution deposit of ₹10,000 is refundable. The fees can be paid by cash or demand draft in favour of 'ACADEMY OF TECHNOLOGY,' payable at Kolkata. Yes, the tuition fees may be revised based on directives from the West Bengal Government. Vidyarthi Mediclaim is a medical insurance for students, and it costs ₹2,500 (one-time payment). The library fees, which cover the Book Bank, Journals, and Digital Library, amount to ₹6,000 (one-time payment). ACADEMY OF TECHNOLOGY Physical Reporting for MCA Admission 2023 after 2nd round @ AOT Candidates allotted a seat in MCA at Academy of Technology and seeking ‘Admission’ must physically report to the campus from 10th October to 13th October, 2023 (11 AM to 4 PM) with the following: 1. The remaining admission fees, that is, Rs. 60,000/- (as per structure provided in https://aot.edu.in/mca-fees-structure/ excluding the Rs. 5000/- already paid to WBJEEB for first enrolment). The fees may be paid in cash or demand draft in favour of ACADEMY OF TECHNOLOGY, payable at Kolkata. 2. All required documents – original for verification and two self-attested copies for submission: i. Admit card of JECA 2023 Examination. ii. Provisional Admission Letter downloaded from WBJEEB counselling portal: www.wbjeeb.nic.in iii. Rank Card of JECA 2023 Examination. iv. 10th admit card/ certificate of respective Board as proof of age. v. 10th & 12th mark sheets. vi. Graduation level final semester mark sheet. (if Hard copy is not available net copy should be attested by the Head of the Institute last attended) vii. College leaving/character certificate from the Head of the Institute last attended. (if available) viii. Respective category certificate. (SC/ ST/ OBC etc.) as per sections 7.0 and 8.0 of Information Bulletin. (if applicable) ix. Aadhar Card of student. x. Domicile certificate as per section 6.0, 6.1 and 6.2 of Information Bulletin. 3. Three copies of stamp size and two copies of passport size colour photograph. Please note: The admission fees and all the documents above as applicable must be with the reporting candidate in order to complete the admission process. Physical reporting without fees and requisite documents will not be considered valid. Title: Academy of Technology
Home About Contact Events Highlights Academics Departments Library moodle Alumni LogIn Departments Library moodle All academic programmes are approved by AICTE, recognized by Department of Higher Education, Government of West Bengal and affiliated to Maulana Abul Kalam Azad University of Technology, West Bengal (formerly West Bengal University of Technology) . Established in 2007, Academy of Technology is one of the most acclaimed self-financed engineering colleges in Karnataka. It has been established by SPDY Educational Development & Charitable Organisation (SPDYEDCO), a trust known for its deep sense of social commitment and dedicated to the promotion of education by inculcating appropriate ethics and attitude. In a metamorphosis of over 18 years, Academy of Technology has been reinventing itself constantly to explore the infinite possibilities of engineering and technology – an academy that inspires everyone to think differently. It is now the preferred career destination for meritorious students due to its academic integrity and standard as well as its attractive campus placement. The remaining admission fees, that is, Rs. 60,000/- (as per structure provided in https://aot.edu.in/mca-fees-structure/ excluding the Rs. 5000/- already paid to WBJEEB for first enrolment). (if Hard copy is not available net copy should be attested by the Head of the Institute last attended) vii. College leaving/character certificate from the Head of the Institute last attended. (if available) viii. Respective category certificate. (SC/ ST/ OBC etc.) as per sections 7.0 and 8.0 of Information Bulletin. (if applicable) ix. Aadhar Card of student. x. Domicile certificate as per section 6.0, 6.1 and 6.2 of Information Bulletin. 3. Three copies of stamp size and two copies of passport size colour photograph. Please note: The admission fees and all the documents above as applicable must be with the reporting candidate in order to complete the admission process. Physical reporting without fees and requisite documents will not be considered valid. ACADEMY OF TECHNOLOGY Physical Reporting for MCA Admission 2023 after 2nd round @ AOT Candidates allotted a seat in MCA at Academy of Technology and seeking ‘Admission’ must physically report to the campus from 10th October to 13th October, 2023 (11 AM to 4 PM) with the following: 1. The remaining admission fees, that is, Rs. 60,000/- (as per structure provided in https://aot.edu.in/mca-fees-structure/ excluding the Rs. 5000/- already paid to WBJEEB for first enrolment). The fees may be paid in cash or demand draft in favour of ACADEMY OF TECHNOLOGY, payable at Kolkata. 2. All required documents – original for verification and two self-attested copies for submission: i. Admit card of JECA 2023 Examination. ii. Provisional Admission Letter downloaded from WBJEEB counselling portal: www.wbjeeb.nic.in iii. Rank Card of JECA 2023 Examination. iv. 10th admit card/ certificate of respective Board as proof of age. v. 10th & 12th mark sheets. vi. Graduation level final semester mark sheet. (if Hard copy is not available net copy should be attested by the Head of the Institute last attended) vii. College leaving/character certificate from the Head of the Institute last attended. (if available) viii. Respective category certificate. (SC/ ST/ OBC etc.) as per sections 7.0 and 8.0 of Information Bulletin. (if applicable) ix. Aadhar Card of student. x. Domicile certificate as per section 6.0, 6.1 and 6.2 of Information Bulletin. 3. Three copies of stamp size and two copies of passport size colour photograph. Please note: The admission fees and all the documents above as applicable must be with the reporting candidate in order to complete the admission process. Physical reporting without fees and requisite documents will not be considered valid. Documents verification for MCA Counselling 2023 after 2nd round @ AOT Timings: 10th October to 13th October, 2023 (11 AM to 4 PM) Documents required: as prescribed in West Bengal Joint Entrance Examinations Board notification

ACADEMY OF TECHNOLOGY Physical Reporting for MCA Admission 2023 after 2nd round @ AOT Candidates allotted a seat in MCA at Academy of Technology and seeking ‘Admission’ must physically report to the campus from 10th October to 13th October, 2023 (11 AM to 4 PM) with the following: 1. The remaining admission fees, that is, Rs. 60,000/- (as per structure provided in https://aot.edu.in/mca-fees-structure/ excluding the Rs. 5000/- already paid to WBJEEB for first enrolment). The fees may be paid in cash or demand draft in favour of ACADEMY OF TECHNOLOGY, payable at Kolkata. 2. All required documents – original for verification and two self-attested copies for submission: i. Admit card of JECA 2023 Examination. ii. Provisional Admission Letter downloaded from WBJEEB counselling portal: www.wbjeeb.nic.in iii. Rank Card of JECA 2023 Examination. iv. 10th admit card/ certificate of respective Board as proof of age. v. 10th & 12th mark sheets. vi. Graduation level final semester mark sheet. (if Hard copy is not available net copy should be attested by the Head of the Institute last attended) vii. College leaving/character certificate from the Head of the Institute last attended. (if available) viii. Respective category certificate. (SC/ ST/ OBC etc.) as per sections 7.0 and 8.0 of Information Bulletin. (if applicable) ix. Aadhar Card of student. x. Domicile certificate as per section 6.0, 6.1 and 6.2 of Information Bulletin. 3. Three copies of stamp size and two copies of passport size colour photograph. Please note: The admission fees and all the documents above as applicable must be with the reporting candidate in order to complete the admission process. Physical reporting without fees and requisite documents will not be considered valid. Documents verification for MCA Counselling 2023 after 2nd round @ AOT Timings: 10th October to 13th October, 2023 (11 AM to 4 PM) Documents required: as prescribed in West Bengal Joint Entrance Examinations Board notification

ACADEMY OF TECHNOLOGY Physical Reporting for MCA Admission 2023 after 2nd round @ AOT Candidates allotted a seat in MCA at Academy of Technology and seeking ‘Admission’ must physically report to the campus from 10th October to 13th October, 2023 (11 AM to 4 PM) with the following: 1. The remaining admission fees, that is, Rs. 60,000/- (as per structure provided in https://aot.edu.in/mca-fees-structure/ excluding the Rs. 5000/- already paid to WBJEEB for first enrolment). The fees may be paid in cash or demand draft in favour of ACADEMY OF TECHNOLOGY, payable at Kolkata. 2. All required documents – original for verification and two self-attested copies for submission: i. Admit card of JECA 2023 Examination. ii. Provisional Admission Letter downloaded from WBJEEB counselling portal: www.wbjeeb.nic.in iii. Rank Card of JECA 2023 Examination. iv. 10th admit card/ certificate of respective Board as proof of age. v. 10th & 12th mark sheets. vi. Graduation level final semester mark sheet. (if Hard copy is not available net copy should be attested by the Head of the Institute last attended) vii. College leaving/character certificate from the Head of the Institute last attended. (if available) viii. Respective category certificate. (SC/ ST/ OBC etc.) as per sections 7.0 and 8.0 of Information Bulletin. (if applicable) ix. Aadhar Card of student. x. Domicile certificate as per section 6.0, 6.1 and 6.2 of Information Bulletin. 3. Three copies of stamp size and two copies of passport size colour photograph. Please note: The admission fees and all the documents above as applicable must be with the reporting candidate in order to complete the admission process. Physical reporting without fees and requisite documents will not be considered valid. Title: Academy of Technology
Home About Contact Events Highlights Academics Departments Library moodle Alumni LogIn Departments Library moodle The Techfest at the Academy of Technology is an annual event that showcases innovation and creativity in various fields of technology. It features a range of activities including workshops, competitions, exhibitions, and lectures from industry experts. Students have the opportunity to display their projects, engage in hands-on learning, and network with professionals. This event aims to inspire and cultivate a passion for technology among attendees, fostering an environment of learning and collaboration. Gamesmeet at the Academy of Technology is an annual gathering focused on gaming and e-sports. It features competitive gaming tournaments, casual gaming sessions, and interactive workshops. Participants can compete in popular games, learn about game development, and connect with fellow gaming enthusiasts. The event aims to promote the gaming culture within the academy, encouraging both fun and educational experiences in the world of video games. The 'Women in Space Engineering' event at the Academy of Technology is a prestigious gathering that highlights the contributions of women in the field of space engineering. Esteemed IIT professors and renowned female scientists from ISRO come together to share their experiences, insights, and advancements in space technology. The event includes inspiring talks, panel discussions, and networking opportunities, aiming to encourage and empower female students to pursue careers in space engineering and related fields. The GDG September Meet at the Academy of Technology is a monthly gathering hosted by the Google Developer Group. It features tech talks, coding sessions, and networking opportunities for developers to share knowledge and collaborate on projects. ACADEMY OF TECHNOLOGY Physical Reporting for MCA Admission 2023 after 2nd round @ AOT Candidates allotted a seat in MCA at Academy of Technology and seeking ‘Admission’ must physically report to the campus from 10th October to 13th October, 2023 (11 AM to 4 PM) with the following: 1. The remaining admission fees, that is, Rs. 60,000/- (as per structure provided in https://aot.edu.in/mca-fees-structure/ excluding the Rs. 5000/- already paid to WBJEEB for first enrolment). The fees may be paid in cash or demand draft in favour of ACADEMY OF TECHNOLOGY, payable at Kolkata. 2. All required documents – original for verification and two self-attested copies for submission: i. Admit card of JECA 2023 Examination. ii. Provisional Admission Letter downloaded from WBJEEB counselling portal: www.wbjeeb.nic.in iii. Rank Card of JECA 2023 Examination. iv. 10th admit card/ certificate of respective Board as proof of age. v. 10th & 12th mark sheets. vi. Graduation level final semester mark sheet. (if Hard copy is not available net copy should be attested by the Head of the Institute last attended) vii. College leaving/character certificate from the Head of the Institute last attended. (if available) viii. Respective category certificate. (SC/ ST/ OBC etc.) as per sections 7.0 and 8.0 of Information Bulletin. (if applicable) ix. Aadhar Card of student. x. Domicile certificate as per section 6.0, 6.1 and 6.2 of Information Bulletin. 3. Three copies of stamp size and two copies of passport size colour photograph. Please note: The admission fees and all the documents above as applicable must be with the reporting candidate in order to complete the admission process. Physical reporting without fees and requisite documents will not be considered valid. Documents verification for MCA Counselling 2023 after 2nd round @ AOT Timings: 10th October to 13th October, 2023 (11 AM to 4 PM) Documents required: as prescribed in West Bengal Joint Entrance Examinations Board notification

Please note: The admission fees and all the documents above as applicable must be with the reporting candidate in order to complete the admission process. ACADEMY OF TECHNOLOGY Physical Reporting for MCA Admission 2023 after 2nd round @ AOT Candidates allotted a seat in MCA at Academy of Technology and seeking ‘Admission’ must physically report to the campus from 10th October to 13th October, 2023 (11 AM to 4 PM) with the following: 1. The remaining admission fees, that is, Rs. 60,000/- (as per structure provided in https://aot.edu.in/mca-fees-structure/ excluding the Rs. 5000/- already paid to WBJEEB for first enrolment). The fees may be paid in cash or demand draft in favour of ACADEMY OF TECHNOLOGY, payable at Kolkata. 2. All required documents – original for verification and two self-attested copies for submission: i. Admit card of JECA 2023 Examination. ii. Provisional Admission Letter downloaded from WBJEEB counselling portal: www.wbjeeb.nic.in iii. Rank Card of JECA 2023 Examination. iv. 10th admit card/ certificate of respective Board as proof of age. v. 10th & 12th mark sheets. vi. Graduation level final semester mark sheet. (if Hard copy is not available net copy should be attested by the Head of the Institute last attended) vii. College leaving/character certificate from the Head of the Institute last attended. (if available) viii. Respective category certificate. (SC/ ST/ OBC etc.) as per sections 7.0 and 8.0 of Information Bulletin. (if applicable) ix. Aadhar Card of student. x. Domicile certificate as per section 6.0, 6.1 and 6.2 of Information Bulletin. 3. Three copies of stamp size and two copies of passport size colour photograph. Please note: The admission fees and all the documents above as applicable must be with the reporting candidate in order to complete the admission process. Physical reporting without fees and requisite documents will not be considered valid. Documents verification for MCA Counselling 2023 after 2nd round @ AOT Timings: 10th October to 13th October, 2023 (11 AM to 4 PM) Documents required: as prescribed in West Bengal Joint Entrance Examinations Board notification

ACADEMY OF TECHNOLOGY Physical Reporting for MCA Admission 2023 after 2nd round @ AOT Candidates allotted a seat in MCA at Academy of Technology and seeking ‘Admission’ must physically report to the campus from 10th October to 13th October, 2023 (11 AM to 4 PM) with the following: 1. The remaining admission fees, that is, Rs. 60,000/- (as per structure provided in https://aot.edu.in/mca-fees-structure/ excluding the Rs. 5000/- already paid to WBJEEB for first enrolment). The fees may be paid in cash or demand draft in favour of ACADEMY OF TECHNOLOGY, payable at Kolkata. 2. All required documents – original for verification and two self-attested copies for submission: i. Admit card of JECA 2023 Examination. ii. Provisional Admission Letter downloaded from WBJEEB counselling portal: www.wbjeeb.nic.in iii. Rank Card of JECA 2023 Examination. iv. 10th admit card/ certificate of respective Board as proof of age. v. 10th & 12th mark sheets. vi. Graduation level final semester mark sheet. (if Hard copy is not available net copy should be attested by the Head of the Institute last attended) vii. College leaving/character certificate from the Head of the Institute last attended. (if available) viii. Respective category certificate. (SC/ ST/ OBC etc.) as per sections 7.0 and 8.0 of Information Bulletin. (if applicable) ix. Aadhar Card of student. x. Domicile certificate as per section 6.0, 6.1 and 6.2 of Information Bulletin. 3. Three copies of stamp size and two copies of passport size colour photograph. Please note: The admission fees and all the documents above as applicable must be with the reporting candidate in order to complete the admission process. Physical reporting without fees and requisite documents will not be considered valid. Documents verification for MCA Counselling 2023 after 2nd round @ AOT Timings: 10th October to 13th October, 2023 (11 AM to 4 PM) Documents required: as prescribed in West Bengal Joint Entrance Examinations Board notification

ACADEMY OF TECHNOLOGY Physical Reporting for MCA Admission 2023 after 2nd round @ AOT Candidates allotted a seat in MCA at Academy of Technology and seeking ‘Admission’ must physically report to the campus from 10th October to 13th October, 2023 (11 AM to 4 PM) with the following: 1. The remaining admission fees, that is, Rs. 60,000/- (as per structure provided in https://aot.edu.in/mca-fees-structure/ excluding the Rs. 5000/- already paid to WBJEEB for first enrolment). The fees may be paid in cash or demand draft in favour of ACADEMY OF TECHNOLOGY, payable at Kolkata. 2. All required documents – original for verification and two self-attested copies for submission: i. Admit card of JECA 2023 Examination. ii. Provisional Admission Letter downloaded from WBJEEB counselling portal: www.wbjeeb.nic.in iii. Rank Card of JECA 2023 Examination. iv. 10th admit card/ certificate of respective Board as proof of age. v. 10th & 12th mark sheets. vi. Graduation level final semester mark sheet. (if Hard copy is not available net copy should be attested by the Head of the Institute last attended) vii. College leaving/character certificate from the Head of the Institute last attended. (if available) viii. Respective category certificate. (SC/ ST/ OBC etc.) as per sections 7.0 and 8.0 of Information Bulletin. (if applicable) ix. Aadhar Card of student. x. Domicile certificate as per section 6.0, 6.1 and 6.2 of Information Bulletin. 3. Three copies of stamp size and two copies of passport size colour photograph. Please note: The admission fees and all the documents above as applicable must be with the reporting candidate in order to complete the admission process. Physical reporting without fees and requisite documents will not be considered valid. ACADEMY OF TECHNOLOGY Physical Reporting for MCA Admission 2023 after 2nd round @ AOT Candidates allotted a seat in MCA at Academy of Technology and seeking ‘Admission’ must physically report to the campus from 10th October to 13th October, 2023 (11 AM to 4 PM) with the following: 1. The remaining admission fees, that is, Rs. 60,000/- (as per structure provided in https://aot.edu.in/mca-fees-structure/ excluding the Rs. 5000/- already paid to WBJEEB for first enrolment). The fees may be paid in cash or demand draft in favour of ACADEMY OF TECHNOLOGY, payable at Kolkata. 2. All required documents – original for verification and two self-attested copies for submission: i. Admit card of JECA 2023 Examination. ii. Provisional Admission Letter downloaded from WBJEEB counselling portal: www.wbjeeb.nic.in iii. Rank Card of JECA 2023 Examination. iv. 10th admit card/ certificate of respective Board as proof of age. v. 10th & 12th mark sheets. vi. Graduation level final semester mark sheet. (if Hard copy is not available net copy should be attested by the Head of the Institute last attended) vii. College leaving/character certificate from the Head of the Institute last attended. (if available) viii. Respective category certificate. (SC/ ST/ OBC etc.) as per sections 7.0 and 8.0 of Information Bulletin. (if applicable) ix. Aadhar Card of student. x. Domicile certificate as per section 6.0, 6.1 and 6.2 of Information Bulletin. 3. Three copies of stamp size and two copies of passport size colour photograph. Please note: The admission fees and all the documents above as applicable must be with the reporting candidate in order to complete the admission process. Physical reporting without fees and requisite documents will not be considered valid. Documents verification for MCA Counselling 2023 after 2nd round @ AOT Timings: 10th October to 13th October, 2023 (11 AM to 4 PM) Documents required: as prescribed in West Bengal Joint Entrance Examinations Board notification

The remaining admission fees, that is, Rs. 60,000/- (as per structure provided in https://aot.edu.in/mca-fees-structure/ excluding the Rs. 5000/- already paid to WBJEEB for first enrolment). All required documents – original for verification and two self-attested copies for submission: i. Admit card of JECA 2023 Examination. ii. Provisional Admission Letter downloaded from WBJEEB counselling portal: www.wbjeeb.nic.in iii. Rank Card of JECA 2023 Examination. iv. 10th admit card/ certificate of respective Board as proof of age. v. 10th & 12th mark sheets. vi. Graduation level final semester mark sheet. (if Hard copy is not available net copy should be attested by the Head of the Institute last attended) vii. College leaving/character certificate from the Head of the Institute last attended. (if available) viii. Respective category certificate. (SC/ ST/ OBC etc.) as per sections 7.0 and 8.0 of Information Bulletin. (if applicable) ix. Aadhar Card of student. x. Domicile certificate as per section 6.0, 6.1 and 6.2 of Information Bulletin. 3. Three copies of stamp size and two copies of passport size colour photograph. Please note: The admission fees and all the documents above as applicable must be with the reporting candidate in order to complete the admission process. Physical reporting without fees and requisite documents will not be considered valid. ACADEMY OF TECHNOLOGY Physical Reporting for MCA Admission 2023 after 2nd round @ AOT Candidates allotted a seat in MCA at Academy of Technology and seeking ‘Admission’ must physically report to the campus from 10th October to 13th October, 2023 (11 AM to 4 PM) with the following: 1. The remaining admission fees, that is, Rs. 60,000/- (as per structure provided in https://aot.edu.in/mca-fees-structure/ excluding the Rs. 5000/- already paid to WBJEEB for first enrolment). The fees may be paid in cash or demand draft in favour of ACADEMY OF TECHNOLOGY, payable at Kolkata. 2. All required documents – original for verification and two self-attested copies for submission: i. Admit card of JECA 2023 Examination. ii. Provisional Admission Letter downloaded from WBJEEB counselling portal: www.wbjeeb.nic.in iii. Rank Card of JECA 2023 Examination. iv. 10th admit card/ certificate of respective Board as proof of age. v. 10th & 12th mark sheets. vi. Graduation level final semester mark sheet. (if Hard copy is not available net copy should be attested by the Head of the Institute last attended) vii. College leaving/character certificate from the Head of the Institute last attended. (if available) viii. Respective category certificate. (SC/ ST/ OBC etc.) as per sections 7.0 and 8.0 of Information Bulletin. (if applicable) ix. Aadhar Card of student. x. Domicile certificate as per section 6.0, 6.1 and 6.2 of Information Bulletin. 3. Three copies of stamp size and two copies of passport size colour photograph. Please note: The admission fees and all the documents above as applicable must be with the reporting candidate in order to complete the admission process. Physical reporting without fees and requisite documents will not be considered valid. Documents verification for MCA Counselling 2023 after 2nd round @ AOT Timings: 10th October to 13th October, 2023 (11 AM to 4 PM) Documents required: as prescribed in West Bengal Joint Entrance Examinations Board notification

ACADEMY OF TECHNOLOGY Physical Reporting for MCA Admission 2023 after 2nd round @ AOT Candidates allotted a seat in MCA at Academy of Technology and seeking ‘Admission’ must physically report to the campus from 10th October to 13th October, 2023 (11 AM to 4 PM) with the following: 1. The remaining admission fees, that is, Rs. 60,000/- (as per structure provided in https://aot.edu.in/mca-fees-structure/ excluding the Rs. 5000/- already paid to WBJEEB for first enrolment). The fees may be paid in cash or demand draft in favour of ACADEMY OF TECHNOLOGY, payable at Kolkata. 2. All required documents – original for verification and two self-attested copies for submission: i. Admit card of JECA 2023 Examination. ii. Provisional Admission Letter downloaded from WBJEEB counselling portal: www.wbjeeb.nic.in iii. Rank Card of JECA 2023 Examination. iv. 10th admit card/ certificate of respective Board as proof of age. v. 10th & 12th mark sheets. vi. Graduation level final semester mark sheet. (if Hard copy is not available net copy should be attested by the Head of the Institute last attended) vii. College leaving/character certificate from the Head of the Institute last attended. (if available) viii. Respective category certificate. (SC/ ST/ OBC etc.) as per sections 7.0 and 8.0 of Information Bulletin. (if applicable) ix. Aadhar Card of student. x. Domicile certificate as per section 6.0, 6.1 and 6.2 of Information Bulletin. 3. Three copies of stamp size and two copies of passport size colour photograph. Please note: The admission fees and all the documents above as applicable must be with the reporting candidate in order to complete the admission process. Physical reporting without fees and requisite documents will not be considered valid. Documents verification for MCA Counselling 2023 after 2nd round @ AOT Timings: 10th October to 13th October, 2023 (11 AM to 4 PM) Documents required: as prescribed in West Bengal Joint Entrance Examinations Board notification

ACADEMY OF TECHNOLOGY Physical Reporting for MCA Admission 2023 after 2nd round @ AOT Candidates allotted a seat in MCA at Academy of Technology and seeking ‘Admission’ must physically report to the campus from 10th October to 13th October, 2023 (11 AM to 4 PM) with the following: 1. The remaining admission fees, that is, Rs. 60,000/- (as per structure provided in https://aot.edu.in/mca-fees-structure/ excluding the Rs. 5000/- already paid to WBJEEB for first enrolment). The fees may be paid in cash or demand draft in favour of ACADEMY OF TECHNOLOGY, payable at Kolkata. 2. All required documents – original for verification and two self-attested copies for submission: i. Admit card of JECA 2023 Examination. ii. Provisional Admission Letter downloaded from WBJEEB counselling portal: www.wbjeeb.nic.in iii. Rank Card of JECA 2023 Examination. iv. 10th admit card/ certificate of respective Board as proof of age. v. 10th & 12th mark sheets. vi. Graduation level final semester mark sheet. (if Hard copy is not available net copy should be attested by the Head of the Institute last attended) vii. College leaving/character certificate from the Head of the Institute last attended. (if available) viii. Respective category certificate. (SC/ ST/ OBC etc.) as per sections 7.0 and 8.0 of Information Bulletin. (if applicable) ix. Aadhar Card of student. x. Domicile certificate as per section 6.0, 6.1 and 6.2 of Information Bulletin. 3. Three copies of stamp size and two copies of passport size colour photograph. Please note: The admission fees and all the documents above as applicable must be with the reporting candidate in order to complete the admission process. Physical reporting without fees and requisite documents will not be considered valid. Domicile certificate as per section 6.0, 6.1 and 6.2 of Information Bulletin. 3. Three copies of stamp size and two copies of passport size colour photograph. Please note: The admission fees and all the documents above as applicable must be with the reporting candidate in order to complete the admission process. Physical reporting without fees and requisite documents will not be considered valid. ACADEMY OF TECHNOLOGY Physical Reporting for MCA Admission 2023 after 2nd round @ AOT Candidates allotted a seat in MCA at Academy of Technology and seeking ‘Admission’ must physically report to the campus from 10th October to 13th October, 2023 (11 AM to 4 PM) with the following: 1. The remaining admission fees, that is, Rs. 60,000/- (as per structure provided in https://aot.edu.in/mca-fees-structure/ excluding the Rs. 5000/- already paid to WBJEEB for first enrolment). The fees may be paid in cash or demand draft in favour of ACADEMY OF TECHNOLOGY, payable at Kolkata. 2. All required documents – original for verification and two self-attested copies for submission: i. Admit card of JECA 2023 Examination. ii. Provisional Admission Letter downloaded from WBJEEB counselling portal: www.wbjeeb.nic.in iii. Rank Card of JECA 2023 Examination. iv. 10th admit card/ certificate of respective Board as proof of age. v. 10th & 12th mark sheets. vi. Graduation level final semester mark sheet. (if Hard copy is not available net copy should be attested by the Head of the Institute last attended) vii. College leaving/character certificate from the Head of the Institute last attended. (if available) viii. Respective category certificate. (SC/ ST/ OBC etc.) as per sections 7.0 and 8.0 of Information Bulletin. (if applicable) ix. Aadhar Card of student. x. Domicile certificate as per section 6.0, 6.1 and 6.2 of Information Bulletin. 3. Three copies of stamp size and two copies of passport size colour photograph. Please note: The admission fees and all the documents above as applicable must be with the reporting candidate in order to complete the admission process. Physical reporting without fees and requisite documents will not be considered valid. Documents verification for MCA Counselling 2023 after 2nd round @ AOT Timings: 10th October to 13th October, 2023 (11 AM to 4 PM) Documents required: as prescribed in West Bengal Joint Entrance Examinations Board notification

ACADEMY OF TECHNOLOGY Physical Reporting for MCA Admission 2023 after 2nd round @ AOT Candidates allotted a seat in MCA at Academy of Technology and seeking ‘Admission’ must physically report to the campus from 10th October to 13th October, 2023 (11 AM to 4 PM) with the following: 1. The remaining admission fees, that is, Rs. 60,000/- (as per structure provided in https://aot.edu.in/mca-fees-structure/ excluding the Rs. 5000/- already paid to WBJEEB for first enrolment). The fees may be paid in cash or demand draft in favour of ACADEMY OF TECHNOLOGY, payable at Kolkata. 2. All required documents – original for verification and two self-attested copies for submission: i. Admit card of JECA 2023 Examination. ii. Provisional Admission Letter downloaded from WBJEEB counselling portal: www.wbjeeb.nic.in iii. Rank Card of JECA 2023 Examination. iv. 10th admit card/ certificate of respective Board as proof of age. v. 10th & 12th mark sheets. vi. Graduation level final semester mark sheet. (if Hard copy is not available net copy should be attested by the Head of the Institute last attended) vii. College leaving/character certificate from the Head of the Institute last attended. (if available) viii. Respective category certificate. (SC/ ST/ OBC etc.) as per sections 7.0 and 8.0 of Information Bulletin. (if applicable) ix. Aadhar Card of student. x. Domicile certificate as per section 6.0, 6.1 and 6.2 of Information Bulletin. 3. Three copies of stamp size and two copies of passport size colour photograph. Please note: The admission fees and all the documents above as applicable must be with the reporting candidate in order to complete the admission process. Physical reporting without fees and requisite documents will not be considered valid. Documents verification for MCA Counselling 2023 after 2nd round @ AOT Timings: 10th October to 13th October, 2023 (11 AM to 4 PM) Documents required: as prescribed in West Bengal Joint Entrance Examinations Board notification

ACADEMY OF TECHNOLOGY Physical Reporting for MCA Admission 2023 after 2nd round @ AOT Candidates allotted a seat in MCA at Academy of Technology and seeking ‘Admission’ must physically report to the campus from 10th October to 13th October, 2023 (11 AM to 4 PM) with the following: 1. The remaining admission fees, that is, Rs. 60,000/- (as per structure provided in https://aot.edu.in/mca-fees-structure/ excluding the Rs. 5000/- already paid to WBJEEB for first enrolment). The fees may be paid in cash or demand draft in favour of ACADEMY OF TECHNOLOGY, payable at Kolkata. 2. All required documents – original for verification and two self-attested copies for submission: i. Admit card of JECA 2023 Examination. ii. Provisional Admission Letter downloaded from WBJEEB counselling portal: www.wbjeeb.nic.in iii. Rank Card of JECA 2023 Examination. iv. 10th admit card/ certificate of respective Board as proof of age. v. 10th & 12th mark sheets. vi. Graduation level final semester mark sheet. (if Hard copy is not available net copy should be attested by the Head of the Institute last attended) vii. College leaving/character certificate from the Head of the Institute last attended. (if available) viii. Respective category certificate. (SC/ ST/ OBC etc.) as per sections 7.0 and 8.0 of Information Bulletin. (if applicable) ix. Aadhar Card of student. x. Domicile certificate as per section 6.0, 6.1 and 6.2 of Information Bulletin. 3. Three copies of stamp size and two copies of passport size colour photograph. Please note: The admission fees and all the documents above as applicable must be with the reporting candidate in order to complete the admission process. Physical reporting without fees and requisite documents will not be considered valid. Documents verification for MCA Counselling 2023 after 2nd round @ AOT Timings: 10th October to 13th October, 2023 (11 AM to 4 PM) Documents required: as prescribed in West Bengal Joint Entrance Examinations Board notification

The remaining admission fees, that is, Rs. 60,000/- (as per structure provided in https://aot.edu.in/mca-fees-structure/ excluding the Rs. 5000/- already paid to WBJEEB for first enrolment). (if Hard copy is not available net copy should be attested by the Head of the Institute last attended) vii. College leaving/character certificate from the Head of the Institute last attended. (if available) viii. Respective category certificate. (SC/ ST/ OBC etc.) as per sections 7.0 and 8.0 of Information Bulletin. (if applicable) ix. Aadhar Card of student. x. Domicile certificate as per section 6.0, 6.1 and 6.2 of Information Bulletin. 3. Three copies of stamp size and two copies of passport size colour photograph. Please note: The admission fees and all the documents above as applicable must be with the reporting candidate in order to complete the admission process. Physical reporting without fees and requisite documents will not be considered valid. ACADEMY OF TECHNOLOGY Physical Reporting for MCA Admission 2023 after 2nd round @ AOT Candidates allotted a seat in MCA at Academy of Technology and seeking ‘Admission’ must physically report to the campus from 10th October to 13th October, 2023 (11 AM to 4 PM) with the following: 1. The remaining admission fees, that is, Rs. 60,000/- (as per structure provided in https://aot.edu.in/mca-fees-structure/ excluding the Rs. 5000/- already paid to WBJEEB for first enrolment). The fees may be paid in cash or demand draft in favour of ACADEMY OF TECHNOLOGY, payable at Kolkata. 2. All required documents – original for verification and two self-attested copies for submission: i. Admit card of JECA 2023 Examination. ii. Provisional Admission Letter downloaded from WBJEEB counselling portal: www.wbjeeb.nic.in iii. Rank Card of JECA 2023 Examination. iv. 10th admit card/ certificate of respective Board as proof of age. v. 10th & 12th mark sheets. vi. Graduation level final semester mark sheet. (if Hard copy is not available net copy should be attested by the Head of the Institute last attended) vii. College leaving/character certificate from the Head of the Institute last attended. (if available) viii. Respective category certificate. (SC/ ST/ OBC etc.) as per sections 7.0 and 8.0 of Information Bulletin. (if applicable) ix. Aadhar Card of student. x. Domicile certificate as per section 6.0, 6.1 and 6.2 of Information Bulletin. 3. Three copies of stamp size and two copies of passport size colour photograph. Please note: The admission fees and all the documents above as applicable must be with the reporting candidate in order to complete the admission process. Physical reporting without fees and requisite documents will not be considered valid. Documents verification for MCA Counselling 2023 after 2nd round @ AOT Timings: 10th October to 13th October, 2023 (11 AM to 4 PM) Documents required: as prescribed in West Bengal Joint Entrance Examinations Board notification
